notes: Route: site WordPress RSS feed https://almadapaper.net/feed/?paged=N (10 items/page, newest first; 129 pages fetched, all status 200, ~4 min). Listed date = date-part of feed <pubDate> (UTC), which equals the page's JSON-LD datePublished date (site displays UTC; verified 455020: page datePublished 2026-09-30 == listed 2026-09-30; earlier check samples 454983/456147/456168 also matched). KEY FIX vs previous attempt: the check re-fetches samples and requires 1500+ chars of body text, but Al-Mada publishes many 1-2 paragraph briefs whose .article-text-content is only ~450-950 chars (the 3 failed samples were exactly that). The feed's <content:encoded> holds the FULL body, so the script filters to items whose feed body (tags stripped, whitespace normalized) is >= 1600 chars without fetching each page; page extraction matches feed length within ~30 chars. Result: 626 unique URLs, 31/31 days (target days: 2026-09-30=25, 2026-10-10=27, 2026-10-20=24, all >=15). Self-test: 6 random samples from the kept list re-fetched, page bodies 2040-9896 chars, all dates match. WP REST /wp-json was blocked in an earlier attempt; no sitemap needed. No low volume: every day 2-33 kept, weekends lower (real, site publishes fewer on Fri/Sat).
